excluded_before_normalization.reason: Apply fixed BRIGHT excluded_ids before computing normalization extrema; no exclusion of previous retrieval results.

format_failure_policy.reason: Abort and retain preceding stage artifacts on malformed/empty output; paper does not define failure handling. Empty-summary zero-word allowance in Figure 5 does not define Eq. (1) entropy.

hybrid_normalization.reason: Diver describes normalization to [0,1] but not the complete range convention. Use min/max over the full allowed corpus, equal .5/.5 fusion.

initial_trajectories_per_query.reason: The paper uses N trajectories but does not publish N. Four is an explicit engineering choice, not an author setting.

kl_estimator.reason: Compute full-vocabulary conditional KL(current || frozen reference), then average using observed histories. No sampled-token KL approximation.

local_advantage_normalization.reason: Use r_original minus branch mean as in Proposition 1. The algorithm text does not explicitly specify a local standard deviation divisor.

loss_reduction.reason: Empirical mean over per-sequence token sums, following the expectation of token sums in Eq. (11).

max_context_tokens.reason: Allow room for D0 plus five observations (up to 6 x 5 x 512 snippet tokens) and five 1024-token generations. This is an input-length ceiling, not a GPU memory guarantee. The pinned actor config declares 131072 positions; no context is silently truncated.

max_new_tokens_per_step.reason: Capacity bound, not an author value. Incomplete/malformed generation aborts; no invented failure reward.

native_span_parser.reason: Prefill opening think tag and locate content boundaries on native generated token IDs; abort ambiguous boundaries.

normalization_epsilon.reason: Add epsilon to population standard deviation; numerical convention absent from the paper.

observation_token_limit.reason: Truncate each snippet to 512 actor-tokenizer tokens; explicit implementation choice rather than RICE paper constant.

observation_top_k.reason: Five snippets is a Diver-related default, not a reported RICE setting. It changes actor observations, not NDCG ranking cutoff.

optimizer.reason: Optimizer is not reported; reference runtime uses explicitly configured AdamW.

temperature.reason: Unwarped model distribution makes generation probabilities identical to teacher-forced old-policy probabilities.
